But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

runs.text: The Parable of the Lost Sheep
Luke 15:1–7
See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
runs.originalText: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.

runs.text: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
runs.originalText: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?

runs.text: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.

runs.text: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.

Deuteronomy 19:15–21
If your brother sins against you,

Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
